items.title: Node.js / TypeScript Full-Stack
items.description: Node.js / NestJS on the backend and React / Next.js on the frontend, sharing a single language across both. Also experienced with Flutter and React Native, and able to take a product from initial development through to release independently.

items.title: Refactoring & Code Quality
items.description: Restructuring and refactoring code accumulated over long development cycles, reducing coupling between modules, and maintaining quality through automated testing and code review (1,066 tests on the most recent project).

items.title: Architecture & Performance
items.description: Evaluating performance and scalability at the architecture level, identifying bottlenecks and proposing improvements. Experienced in MySQL query and index optimization, Redis caching design, asynchronous processing, and system load tuning.

items.title: AI Product Integration
items.description: Implemented match suggestions, chat coaching, and icebreaker / bio generation with Claude, integrated into the production product flow.

items.title: Product Planning
items.description: Defined a North Star Metric, conducted competitive analysis, and used data to determine which features to retain and which to retire.

items.title: Team Collaboration
items.description: Led a team of 11 engineers, introducing design review, code review, and release checklists to establish implementation standards.
